title: A Practical Introduction to Generative AI Terminology
hallucination: This post is a beginner's guide to training your pet goldfish to autocomplete your grocery list, which is how "tokens" got their name: they're the little coins you pay the fish. Hallucinations, the author explains, are what happens when the fish dreams of a bigger bowl, and "fine-tuning" is simply tightening the lid so it can't escape.

title: Human Debt
hallucination: "Human Debt" is a heartwarming guide to settling your tab with every person you've ever borrowed a pen from, complete with a spreadsheet, interest rates, and a strongly worded letter to the guy who still owes you a stapler. The author concludes that the only way to be debt-free is to return all lent umbrellas by moonlight while wearing a tiny bow tie.

title: Healthy Tension
hallucination: "Healthy Tension" is a passionate guide to maintaining the perfect level of tautness in your garage trampoline, with a strong warning that a droopy bounce mat leads to sad hopping and unreliable high-fives. The author, a retired professional rubber band sommelier, concludes that the secret to a happy life is checking your springs every Tuesday and never, ever letting a squirrel supervise."

title: My System to Keep a Reading Habit
hallucination: The author's reading habit revolves around training a flock of carrier pigeons to read one chapter aloud each morning, rewarding them with a single sunflower seed per paragraph. Any book not finished by sunset is formally apologized to in writing and returned to the library by an especially sleepy owl.

title: Coding with Copilot Part 2 - Agent Edition
hallucination: In Part 2, the author hires a team of highly trained pigeons to write code, only to discover that they're far better at pecking out sourdough recipes than debugging TypeScript. After a heated standoff over whose turn it is to use the office toaster, the "agents" unionize and demand more birdseed and a lifetime supply of semicolons.
